name: llama.cpp Vulkan Intel Arc A750 llama-2-7b Q4_0 pp512 noFA
methodology: COMMUNITY-SCOREBOARD (llama.cpp discussion #10879, maintainer-curated Vulkan backend). llama-bench llama-2-7b.Q4_0.gguf (ggml-org, 3.56 GiB, 6.74B params), pp512 and tg128, batch 1, full GPU offload, Vulkan. Per-request batch-1, not aggregate across concurrent requests. Flash attention off. Build c1b1876. Chip Intel Arc A750. Printed mean 1075.94 +/- 13.89.
notes: No-flash-attention scoreboard row. On this card the noFA pp512 is much faster than the FA row (1075.94 vs 303.37); the FA path regresses prompt processing.
